text:
Jordan: Moving cross-country next week, clearing out a few office things. Up for grabs: one LG 32UN88 32" 4K monitor (USB-C, stand included), a fully assembled sit-stand converter (fits up to 70lbs), and 2x SF Giants tickets (Sept 18, lower deck). Free, pickup SF SoMa. Pics: https://imgur.com/gallery/xyz123
Priya: Oof that monitor is the one I wanted last year 62e DMing now for pickup deets.
Tomas: I can take the converter if it's still around. Will need it Sat morning to move it to my Apt.
Jordan: Converter is fairly heavy but no disassembly needed. Pickup windows: ```Thu 5:30-6:30pm
Sat 9:00-11:00am```Message me to lock a slot.
Keiko: DM sent for a ticket pair if still available. Going to a wedding but might take one if possible.
Priya: Confirmed DM; I can swing by Thu 5:45 and have a small hatchback for the monitor.
Tomas: Confirmed Sat 9:30 and I can bring a hand truck. Happy to help move if someone needs it.
Office-bot: Heads-up: please do not post full addresses in public channels. Use DMs for pickup location. :robot_face:
Jordan: Thanks! I'll DM everyone with the building buzzer and closest BART stop. Tickets reserved for Keiko and Priya pending DM confirmation. Converter tentatively to Tomas. Monitor -> Priya if Thu works.
Priya: Thu works. Also can someone confirm monitor has DP/HDMI cable? I have USB-C but not HDMI cable handy.
Jordan: Includes USB-C and DisplayPort cables. No HDMI adapter though.
Tomas: Bringing a dolly. If anyone needs help carrying from lobby to car I can wait 10-15min.
Keiko: If the tickets fall through, I can take the monitor instead (finding who to go to the game with is hard).
Jordan: Noted. First confirmed DM gets it. I'll post final update after pickups. Thanks y'all :)
